name: Semi-arid continental
description: Cold winters and hot dry summers with 250-400 mm annual rainfall; rainfed cereal production depends on stored winter soil moisture.

name: Hot semi-arid
description: Very hot summers exceeding 40 C with mild winters and 350-500 mm rainfall concentrated in winter; irrigation is required for summer crops.

name: Mediterranean
description: Mild wet winters and hot dry summers with 600-750 mm rainfall; supports perennial tree crops and irrigated summer field crops.

name: Humid subtropical
description: High year-round rainfall above 1000 mm with mild winters and high humidity; favours perennial nut and tea production and elevates fungal disease pressure.
